input.quote: Section 8.3 Termination. This Agreement will terminate on the earlier to occur of (a) the date upon which the last remaining Receivable is paid in full, settled, sold or written off and any amounts received are applied and (b) the Issuer is terminated under Section 8.1 of the Trust Agreement.
input.rationale: This is a securitization transfer and servicing agreement with no term-and-renewal structure. Searches for "renew", "automatically renew", "extension/expiration/successive/anniversary" and any fee-uplift mechanic returned no renewal provision anywhere: Article VIII (Sections 8.1-8.3) provides only optional acquisition/redemption and a single termination trigger, and Section 8.3 runs the Agreement until the last Receivable is paid in full, settled, sold or written off or the Issuer is terminated under the Trust Agreement. Because there is no automatic renewal, every conditional element of the preferred position (12-month renewal terms, 30-day opt-out, 60-day Vendor reminder, CPI/3% uplift cap) is satisfied vacuously, and there is no non-renewal notice window or price-escalation mechanic that could fall into fallback or walk-away territory (no multi-year auto-renewal, no >90-day notice window). Any extension of the deal would have to be effected by amendment, which Section 10.1(a) frames as an act of "the parties", i.e., by mutual written agreement, consistent with the preferred position. Nothing here is adverse to us, so no redline is warranted; we record RENEWAL as not applicable to this term structure.
